name: Solomon Island Coastal Undercurrent
scope: Editorial eastern Solomon Islands reach between offshore gates near 162.0 E, 9.6 S and 155.8 E, 4.6 S, following island-chain geography toward northeast Bougainville. Excludes the SEC upstream basin, Solomon Strait crossing, New Ireland coastal continuation and EUC. Source descriptions establish regional context; continuity between gates is unresolved. These are OSW truncations, not observed origins or termination.
layer: Subsurface thermocline context of the 2010 model proposal. Its indexed mean-flow discussion uses sigma 24.0-26.5, not a fixed 100-400 m slab. The later 2012 ADCP averages and tracer profiles do not supply one common continuous SICU core layer.
time_convention: Static OSW geographic reference. The 2010 model mean and July-August 2012 regional observations are separate evidence contexts. Neither dates these editorial vertices or establishes seasonal route changes.
source_locator: Melet et al. (2010) coauthor abstract proposes SICU east of Solomon Islands; original model axis not acquired. Ganachaud et al. (2017), Figures 2 and 7 and pages 11-12/17, supply island geography and local observational context, not a continuous SICU axis.
source_citation: Melet, Gourdeau, Kessler, Verron and Molines (2010), Thermocline circulation in the Solomon Sea: A modeling study, J. Phys. Oceanogr. 40, 1302–1319, doi:10.1175/2009JPO4264.1.
source_license: Coauthor abstract paraphrased. Ganachaud et al. (2017) original CC BY 4.0 paper retained with attribution; no original scientific figure is incorporated into this editorial map.
coordinate_selection: OSW selects coarse offshore vertices on the Pacific side of the Solomon Islands. No source figure is digitized and no station 13-to-43 similarity proves a continuous path. Initial central-chain vertices and the farther-offshore variant touched coarse land near Malaita; central vertices were moved east of the island-chain mask and all 81 scenarios regenerated. The drawn reach is a geographic reference with unresolved coastal clearance and core position, not a measured coastal axis.

alternative_routes.interpretation: OSW geographic alternative, not a measured axis or current edge.

scenario_rule: Three geographic shapes crossed with uniform longitude shifts -0.05/0/+0.05 degree and independent endpoint latitude shifts -0.1/0/+0.1 degree: 81 editorial scenarios. Not width, seasonal extent or statistical confidence.
remaining_gates: Acquire and visually review the original 2010 model Figure 4 before digitizing a model axis.
Review finer coastline and bathymetry, source velocity fields and the density-dependent flow before identifying an actual current core.
Resolve complete entrance/exit gates and connectivity to NICU separately; no connector across Solomon Strait is drawn.
No whole-current width, annual range, dated footprint or NASA surface identification inferred.

supporting_sources.label: Ganachaud et al. (2017), Solomon Sea cruises
supporting_sources.access: Original NOAA-hosted PDF acquired and institutional SHA256 matched; CC BY 4.0 printed page 27; selected pages and figures inspected.

method: Sum shortest WGS84 geodesic distances between successive OSW editorial vertices; no velocity field or current core is reconstructed.
map_land_check: All 81 routes, geodesically densified at spacing no greater than 10 km, avoid the coarse OSW atlas land mask in display coordinates. This is not a shelf-break, reef, bathymetric or high-resolution land-clearance verification.
state_relation_role: Editorial line/display-region crossing; physical current passage unresolved.
